description: Shared schema-11 practice-state validation contract (M2 PR 1 R3). Each runner builds a fresh database from the registered migrations, applies `baseline` then a case's `sql`, closes and reopens the database (so writable_schema edits take effect), and runs its validator. Native: crate::backup::verify_schema_11_semantics. Browser/Node: validatePracticeState. Both must return the same accept/refuse outcome for every case. Every value is synthetic.

PRAGMA writable_schema = OFF
